title: Venus Has a Bizarre Time Anomaly
hook: On Venus, a single day lasts longer than its entire year.
script: On Venus, a single day lasts longer than its entire year. That sounds impossible, right? But it's true! Venus spins incredibly slowly, taking about 243 Earth days to complete one rotation. Meanwhile, its orbit around the Sun is much faster, only 225 Earth days. Imagine living there. The sun would rise and set only once during your entire trip around the sun! This extreme slowness also contributes to its scorching surface temperatures, trapping heat with a super-dense atmosphere. It’s a truly mind-bending cosmic clock where on Venus, a single day lasts longer than its entire year.
